summary: MaintHelp is a maintenance utility screen for displaying, editing, adding, and deleting help text records for various screens in the application. It features an alphabetically indexed grid view for fast navigation of help entries by their 'ScreenName', with support for alternate titles/text (locales), searching, validation, modal editing, and error/warning messaging.
purpose: To maintain help content records for application screens, allowing administrators to manage help text, alternate text, and titles for user-facing guidance. The screen supports add/edit/delete, search and filter, and displays warnings/errors.

fields.name: ScreenName
fields.description: Identifier linking help content to specific screens.

fields.name: HelpTitle
fields.description: Main title for the help content.

fields.name: HelpTitleAlt
fields.description: Alternate title (for different locale or context).

workflows.name: Add Help Entry
steps: Fill in ScreenName, HelpTitle, HelpText, optional HelpTitleAlt, HelpTextAlt.

workflows.name: Search/Filter Help Entries
steps: Select optional 'starts with' letter or ALL.

workflows.name: Preview Help Screen
steps: JavaScript opens new window for previewing help content.

business_rules: ScreenName must be unique and specified.
Alternate locale fields (HelpTitleAlt, HelpTextAlt) are optional.
Search defaults to '%' (all) if keyword not specified.
conditions: If in edit mode, ScreenName is shown as label and is not editable.
If in add mode, ScreenName field is editable.
If keyword is empty, search grid with all entries ('%').
If delete is confirmed, remove entry and refresh grid.
system_behavior: GridView displays entries, supports add/edit/delete and alphabet navigation.
ModalPopupExtender used for modal add/edit forms.
Search/filter controls update grid contents live.
Preview opens window for help content.
exceptions: Show error panel on failed validation.
Show warning panel for status messages.
Hide modal/details on cancel or after save/delete.
